purpose: Prepare a privacy-bounded normalized state contract and passive TouchDesigner renderer scaffold without starting applications.

activities.label: define bounded normalized state and safe UNKNOWN behavior
derive a bounded visual plan without treating input as intent or gaze
connect 046 geometry UV to focus while preserving ambiguous monitor states
write a manual-state TouchDesigner CHOP/TOP scaffold with inactive transport
run standard-library contract and static privacy checks

queries.expression: does stale low-confidence malformed state become UNKNOWN and neutral renderer channels
does the prepared bootstrap avoid camera capture input process and active transport startup
does the scaffold expose manual state filtered state and a visual output without claiming runtime verification

assumptions: TouchDesigner 2023.12000 is the user's installed version.
The host will later provide already-normalized values; this slice does not implement capture.
A local normalized state contract is safer than sending raw frames or arbitrary payloads to the renderer.
TouchDesigner parameter names and node creation behavior remain to be verified in the user's licensed runtime.
kill_tests: A stale, low-confidence, future-clock or malformed state must not be accepted.
Raw unknown keys must not reach renderer channels.
The bootstrap must not activate OSC or create camera, capture, input or process dependencies.
The bootstrap must not overwrite an existing renderer container.
This experiment must not claim that TouchDesigner, Maxine, Spout or license-specific nodes were run.
unknowns: Whether the installed TouchDesigner edition exposes Spout, Shared Memory or Direct Display Out.
Whether Face Track CHOP's Maxine runtime is installed and compatible.
Whether the host-to-renderer transport will be Spout, shared memory or a later local numeric channel.
Measured source-to-render latency and GPU/CPU load.
Whether each target application exposes useful UI Automation semantics.
